turns.text: how do i create abha for a patient using aadhar otp, which apis in what order

must_contain: The journey starts with POST /abha/api/v3/enrollment/request/otp with scope abha-enrol, loginHint aadhaar, the encrypted Aadhaar number as loginId and otpSystem aadhaar, and you keep the txnId it returns.
The account is created by POST /abha/api/v3/enrollment/enrol/byAadhaar, sending the txnId, the encrypted OTP, the communication mobile and the consent block.
If the Aadhaar already has an ABHA, enrol/byAadhaar returns that account with isNew false instead of creating a second one, so read isNew before telling the person anything was created.
notes:
First-day developer asking for the call order of the main M1 create journey, with the 'aadhar' misspelling. The isNew fact is the one a wrong answer misses. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/flows/m1-create-abha-aadhaar-otp.md, 'POST /abha/api/v3/enrollment/request/otp
scope [abha-enrol], loginHint aadhaar, loginId (encrypted Aadhaar), otpSystem aadhaar'; 'Request the OTP with scope `abha-enrol` and keep the `txnId`. Enrol with `enrol/byAadhaar`, sending the encrypted OTP, the communication mobile and the consent block'; 'Enrolment for an Aadhaar that already has an ABHA returns that account with `isNew` false, so read `isNew` before telling the person anything was created.' catalogue/hiecm/endpoints/m1-enrolment-by-aadhaar.md, 'If an ABHA already exists for that Aadhaar, the call returns it instead of creating a second one, and `isNew` is false.'
